items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: So Bunk joined the band with us in Alexandria.

ctx.x: I see. See? And that's why Bunk, we meets Bunk on the road. Yeah. We meet Bunk in Alexandria. So Bunk joined the band with us in Alexandria. See? Our headquarters were in Crowley. Yes. And so after the band... Well... The band didn't play it over five jobs was before he got killed.
So it didn't last long then. Yeah.
